common_prompt.asset_type: Finalizable 64-logical-pixel Planting Base candidate for the existing Godot tower-defense game.
common_prompt.function: The building must visually support both seedling multiplication and converting a seedling into timber.
common_prompt.style: True coarse pixel art with uniform square logical pixels, hard stair-step edges, no antialiasing, blur, or subpixel texture; coherent palette suitable for reduction to at most 64 visible colors.
common_prompt.composition: Centered orthographic three-quarter top-down view, upper-left key light, readable top/front/right planes, compact bottom-centered silhouette.
common_prompt.size_contract: 64x64 logical-pixel canvas; final selected redraw must keep the subject at or below 60x60 logical pixels with margin for a separate progress border.
common_prompt.constraints: No baked progress frame, text, UI, character, ground tile, external cast shadow, loose surrounding props, extra building, or watermark.

repair.reason: The superseded source measured 72x77 logical cells and was center-sampled a second time to 57x60, skipping rows and columns and visibly fracturing continuous forms.

prompt_spec.primary_request: Redraw the selected Planting Base as a genuinely lower-logical-resolution pixel sprite while preserving its exact identity, composition, camera angle, proportions, silhouette, and functional motifs.
prompt_spec.preserve: Centered squat stone-and-root cultivation base; symmetric wooden arch with leaves; one suspended green leaf catalyst; one central sapling and soil basin; four lime energy channels; front seedling drawer; right timber cubby; warm wood, gray stone, brown soil, and lime-green palette.
prompt_spec.native_logical_pixel_requirement: Visible subject about 44-48 logical pixels wide and 48-52 tall, never above 54x56 requested; each logical pixel rendered as a uniform 18-22 physical-pixel square; nearest-neighbor-upscaled appearance; connected one-cell-or-thicker outlines; merge micro-details; no broken rings, roots, channels, or highlight crumbs; at most 24-28 intended flat colors.
prompt_spec.background: Perfectly flat uniform solid #FF00FF chroma-key background with generous padding.
prompt_spec.constraints: Crisp hard pixel edges; no antialiasing, smoothing, dithering, gradients inside a logical cell, subpixel details, split cells, semitransparency, background shadow/ground/glow/texture, text, watermark, or extra props.
prompt_spec.output_intent: High-resolution carrier for exactly one measured-cell center sample, followed by bottom-center placement on a 64x64 transparent canvas; no second fitting resample.
